summary: Implemented rule E3695 to validate ElastiCache cluster engines, without committing or running anything. Changes: (1) new rule class src/cfnlint/rules/resources/elasticache/CacheClusterEngine.py, modeled on the RDS DbClusterEngineVersion rule (E3690), targeting Resources/AWS::ElastiCache::CacheCluster/Properties; (2) new enum schema src/cfnlint/data/schemas/extensions/aws_elasticache_cachecluster/engine.json allowing memcached, redis, valkey; (3) new unit test test/unit/rules/resources/elasticache/test_cache_cluster_engine.py; (4) a E3695 row added to docs/rules.md. The engine list comes from known ElastiCache engines, not the bundled schema, which has no enum for Engine. Tests were not run, so the new test is unverified.
